chunks: Given water from the boiling spring to drink.
ai.seo_question: What do disbelievers drink from in Hell according to Surah Al-Ghashiyah?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Mutaffifin is often linked with the preceding verse to contrast the pure, sweet drink of the righteous with the boiling, impure fluid of the disbelievers, emphasizing the spiritual corruption that leads to physical torment. The 'boiling spring' (Ain al-Tin) symbolizes a punishment tailored to the specific nature of their denial, serving as a vivid illustration of divine justice where the consequence mirrors the cause of their rejection.
